label: Jobs
description: The broker the customers' queued work goes through. As written, the in-process broker, whose queues live as long as the process that published to them, so a message is consumed by the process whose route put it there: that is the laptop's, under live and local. Under production and production-scheduler it stands for customers-postgres.connection.json, the table broker of the database the customers are kept in: the queue is a table beside them, every instance shares it, and a publish in an atomic graph there would commit with the writes around it. Both kinds deliver at least once, which is what lets one stand in for the other (C018).
